source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: Download Index polygons spatial data (INSPIRE). Data showing the indicative extent and position of registered freehold properties in England and Wales. This dataset was published on 5 July 2026. New files are published on the first Sunday of every month. London Borough of Enfield | Download .gml.

source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: INSPIRE Index Polygons is an open source dataset. Each polygon has a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID. The polygons and attributes are available under the Open Government Licence. The dataset is updated on the first Sunday of each month and files are published as GML.

source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: HM Land Registry data is captured against the British National Grid. GML can be converted to other GIS formats. Re-projection from British National Grid to WGS84 may shift positions by up to 15 metres.
source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: GML processing, British National Grid, reprojection caution
